newsitem.title: ITALY: Mystery surrounds missing Ethiopian soccer team.
newsitem.headline: Mystery surrounds missing Ethiopian soccer team.

text.p: Several members of a 23-member Ethiopian national soccer team decided to stay in Italy on Tuesday rather than fly to Casablanca for an African National Cup match against Morocco, the Ethiopian embassy said.

"It is a personal decision. Some people do not want to go," an Ethiopian embassy spokesman said. "At the moment we do not know why they do not want to go to Morocco and we cannot say how many players are involved," he added.

Earlier on Tuesday Ethiopian state radio reported that most of the team had disappeared while on a 16-hour stopover in Rome. It said the team leader had asked to return home with the remaining players saying they could not now take on Morocco.
The players arrived on Monday afternoon from Addis Ababa and were scheduled to fly to Casablanca on Tuesday. "They missed the flight," an official at Rome's main airport said.
The group stayed overnight in a hotel close to the Italian capital and the hotel manager told Reuters seven members of the original group were still there.
"The embassy called on Tuesday morning saying seven people would stay on," Alvaro Benedetti said.
It was not immediately clear if they were the players who had deserted. The embassy declined to give further details.
